title: orbitopt cross-environment mission plan (CrossEnvPlan v1)
description: One command's worth of cross-environment orchestration (task #270, E5-03): the shared mission scenario, a map from environment label to Python interpreter, and the stages in execution order -- each stage naming the runner that flies its leg, the environment that runs it, and the earlier stages whose sealed exchanges it consumes. Interpreter values may use ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default} so one packaged plan serves any machine; orbitopt.crossenv.plan.load_plan expands, checks the cross-field rules the schema cannot express (unique stage ids, consumes referencing only earlier stages, env defined) and resolves every relative path against the repository root. Compatibility policy as everywhere: unknown optional fields ignored; breaking changes get crossenv-plan-2.0.json.

scenario.description: The mission scenario (two-stage-leo config) every stage loads. Relative paths resolve against the repository root.

out.description: Default output root; the CLI --out flag overrides it.

environments.description: Environment label -> Python interpreter (a command on PATH or a path); values pass through ${VAR} / ${VAR:-default} expansion.

consumes.description: Earlier stage ids whose sealed exchange must validate before this stage runs.
